name: Disable Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser task
description: Stops the periodic CompatTelRunner.exe compatibility scan.
benefit: Prevents CompatTelRunner.exe CPU and disk spikes, which can coincide with gaming sessions.
drawback: Windows gathers less application-compatibility data for feature-update readiness. Windows Update itself is not affected.
recommendedFor: Gaming PCs that see CompatTelRunner.exe activity.
evidence: Task documented as part of Windows compatibility telemetry.

name: Disable Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser Exp task (Windows 11 24H2+)
description: Stops the newer variant of the periodic compatibility appraisal scan.
mechanism: schtasks /Change /DISABLE on \Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser Exp, which replaces the original task on recent Windows 11 builds.
benefit: Prevents CompatTelRunner.exe CPU and disk spikes during gaming sessions.
drawback: Windows gathers less application-compatibility data for feature-update readiness. Windows Update itself is not affected.
evidence: Task name observed on Windows 11 build 26200. On older builds it does not exist and is shown as Unsupported.

name: Disable ProgramDataUpdater task
description: Stops the program inventory collection task.
mechanism: schtasks /Change /DISABLE on \Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\ProgramDataUpdater (present on older builds only).
evidence: Part of Application Experience telemetry. Missing on recent builds (shown as Unsupported).

name: Disable CEIP Consolidator task
description: Stops the Customer Experience Improvement Program data consolidation task.
benefit: Removes a periodic background data-collection run.
recommendedFor: Everyone who opts out of CEIP.

name: Disable CEIP USB data task
description: Stops collection of USB usage statistics for CEIP.
benefit: Removes a periodic background data-collection run.
recommendedFor: Everyone who opts out of CEIP.
evidence: CEIP task; absent on some builds (shown as Unsupported).

name: Disable Feedback (SIUF) DmClient task
description: Stops the Feedback Hub data-management task.
benefit: Removes a periodic feedback-related background task.
drawback: Feedback Hub surveys may not be delivered.
recommendedFor: Users who don't use Feedback Hub.
evidence: Feedback task documented under Windows feedback settings.

name: Disable Feedback (SIUF) scenario download task
description: Stops the task that downloads feedback scenarios.
drawback: Feedback Hub scenarios may not be delivered.
recommendedFor: Users who don't use Feedback Hub.

name: Disable Disk Diagnostic data collector task
description: Stops the task that collects disk diagnostic data for Microsoft.
benefit: Removes a periodic background collection task.
drawback: Less diagnostic data about disk problems is reported. SMART failure warnings (DiskDiagnosticResolver) are not affected.
evidence: Part of the CEIP/Disk Diagnostics task set.

name: Disable Maps update tasks
description: Stops automatic offline-map update checks and toasts.
benefit: Removes periodic background map update checks.
drawback: Offline maps must be updated manually.
evidence: Maps tasks documented with the Maps app.

name: Disable Windows Error Reporting queue task
description: Stops the task that uploads queued error reports.
benefit: Queued crash reports are not uploaded in the background.
drawback: Microsoft and app developers receive fewer crash reports, which can delay fixes for problems you experience.
evidence: WER task. Crash dumps are still written locally.
